parts.html: design, production in Europe and implementation

DUMSKAYA DESIGN Bratislava, Slovakia develops and delivers turnkey furniture projects for residential and commercial properties in the USA. We provide a full-cycle service — from concept development and furniture design to in-house production in Europe, international delivery, and on-site installation coordination.
We work with projects of any scale:
What is included in a turnkey furniture project
We ensure a cohesive design, precise execution, and full control at every stage of the process:

items: furniture concept development and space zoning
custom furniture design for all zones
selection of materials, finishes, and hardware
organization of international delivery to the USA
coordination of furniture installation on site

parts.html: You receive a fully completed turnkey furniture project, carefully designed down to the smallest details and fully adapted for implementation in the USA.
Furniture production and delivery: 4–5 months from approval of the finalized project
Residential and commercial projects in the USA
We work with private and business clients, taking into account the requirements of the U.S. market, operational specifics, and the format of each property.
